news.title: Melvine Malard on half-time wake-up call and love for Baltimore
news.title_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德（Melvine Malard）中场休息时的警钟和对巴尔的摩的热爱
news.body_en: Melvine Malard described the striker’s instinct that saw her fire in a brace in our 3-1 win against Crystal Palace on Sunday, but also explained how the team needed a jolt at half-time to spark the comeback. The Eagles took the lead from a corner after 20 minutes, which meant we trailed at half-time for the first time this season. It took just five minutes after the restart for Malard to net her first of the afternoon and then she headed in from second-half substitute Sandy Baltimore’s cross 25 minutes later. The number nine then won a penalty in the final stages of the match, which Baltimore scored to complete the 3-1 victory. With the three points successfully in the bag, Malard explained how the team reacted in the dressing room at the interval. ‘It was so good to win today because it was a hard game with the wind,’ she explained. ‘But the team could keep going and put the energy into this game. ‘We said “wake up” at half time because it wasn’t a very good start to the game, but we know our quality; we know the way we needed to play to win the game. When we came back out in the second half, we showed that quality.’ Malard shot wide of the target right before she scored from 25 yards out, and she explained how that missed opportunity spurred her on to shoot from distance. ‘I was really in the action before when I missed, and so I knew my touch was good,’ she said. ‘I told myself to shoot and that’s what I did. I am in a good place. This is a seriously good team, and we have good staff.’ Malard paid tribute to Baltimore for a superb second-half display after the pair combined on both the second and third goals against Palace. ‘I love her,’ the striker beamed. ‘She has a lot of quality to go 1-v-1, and as a striker, you only need to go in the box, and she can give you the ball. She showed that today when she came in to help the team. ‘We will take the energy we put in today to the Roma game on Wednesday. We scored three goals today, so that is good. We will keep going to score the goals.’
news.body_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德描述了这位前锋在周日 3-1 战胜水晶宫的比赛中梅开二度的直觉，同时也解释了球队如何需要在半场休息时振作起来，以引发逆转。 20分钟后老鹰队通过角球取得领先，这意味着我们本赛季第一次在半场落后。比赛重新开始后仅五分钟，马拉德就攻入了下午的第一个进球，25 分钟后，她接到下半场替补桑迪·巴尔的摩的传中头球破门。随后，9号球员在比赛最后阶段获得点球，巴尔的摩队最终以3-1获胜。成功拿下三分后，马拉德在中场休息时解释了球队在更衣室的反应。 “今天获胜真是太好了，因为这是一场艰难的比赛，风很大，”她解释道。 “但是球队可以继续前进，并将精力投入到这场比赛中。 “我们在中场休息时说‘醒来’，因为这不是一个很好的比赛开局，但我们知道我们的实力；我们知道我们需要采取什么方式来赢​​得比赛。当我们在下半场扳回一城时，我们展现出了这样的实力。”马拉德在 25 码外射门之前射门偏出目标，她解释了这次错失的机会如何促使她进行远射。 “之前当我失手的时候，我真的很投入，所以我知道我的手感很好，”她说。 “我告诉自己要开枪，我就这么做了。我处于一个好地方。这是一支非常优秀的球队，我们有优秀的员工。”在对阵水晶宫队的第二个和第三个进球后，马拉德对巴尔的摩下半场的出色表现表示敬意。 “我爱她，”前锋微笑着说。 “她有很强的一对一能力，作为一名前锋，你只需要进入禁区，她就能把球传给你。今天当她进来帮助球队时，她就证明了这一点。 `我们将把今天投入的精力带到周三对阵罗马的比赛中。今天我们进了三个球，这很好。我们将继续进球。

news.title: Sonia Bompastor on Malard 'banger' and second-half turnaround
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特谈马拉德的“猛击”和下半场的逆转
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor explained how the weather made things difficult for Chelsea away at Crystal Palace on Sunday, but hailed the quality of French duo Melvine Malard and Sandy Baltimore for our second-half turnaround. The Blues went in at the break 1-0 down after the home side netted from a corner, but a brace from Malard plus a late penalty from substitute Baltimore secured a 3-1 win despite the initial setback. Our head coach explained exactly how we reversed the deficit in tricky circumstances and gave insight into what she said at half-time to galvanise the side. ‘The weather was not helpful today,’ she said. ‘Especially for a team like us who like to play on the ground, it didn't help. We probably didn't create as much as I would have liked to in the first half. ‘The second half was a better performance. We played more with the wind, which helped a little bit as well. The quality of the players who came in was good again, and they brought the impact we needed to win the game. ‘We needed to stay confident in these moments. It's really important to stay calm, even if the result is not in our hands and the weather is not helpful. I knew in the second half we had enough quality to create and to score some goals. ‘The message was around adjusting some of the defensive aspects a little but also giving the players a lot of confidence with the ball. I wanted us to keep trying, because I knew we would have opportunities, and in those moments we were clinical.’ Malard would’ve scored a hat-trick had her third goal not been ruled offside on Sunday afternoon, and it was the number nine that won the penalty on 88 minutes. Baltimore created the assist for Malard’s second and converted the spot-kick at the end of the game, leaving Bompastor full of praise for her compatriots. ‘The French players showed up today, and it was really needed,’ the head coach continued. ‘I'm happy for them, especially Sandy. She hasn't had a lot of minutes recently, but that was the best answer she could give to me. Her performance was really good. ‘When you play a team that is sitting more in the low block, she brings a lot of quality on crosses, but also on the ball, and she can beat her opponent one-on-one. That was a big help today. ‘I wasn't expecting Melvine to score from distance like that. It's a banger, as you say here! She has the ability to create those goals. She's an important player for us and I'm glad for her that she scored a really difficult goal. She could have scored an easy one just before. It makes things even better for her, and scoring like that is always good for her confidence.'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释了周日客场对阵水晶宫的比赛中天气如何给切尔西造成了困难，但她对法国二人组梅尔文·马拉德和桑迪·巴尔的摩在下半场扭转局面的表现表示赞赏。中场休息时，主队角球破门，蓝军以 1-0 落后，但马拉德梅开二度，再加上替补出场的巴尔的摩在最后时刻的点球，尽管最初遭遇挫折，但蓝军还是以 3-1 获胜。我们的主教练准确地解释了我们如何在棘手的情况下逆转比分，并深入分析了她在半场时所说的话，以激励球队。 “今天的天气不太好，”她说。 “特别是对于像我们这样喜欢在地面上比赛的球队来说，这没有帮助。上半场我们可能没有创造出我想要的那么多。 ‘下半场表现更好。我们更多地利用风，这也有一点帮助。上场球员的素质再次出色，他们为我们带来了赢得比赛所需的影响。 “在这些时刻我们需要保持信心。保持冷静非常重要，即使结果不在我们手中并且天气也无济于事。我知道下半场我们有足够的实力来创造机会并取得一些进球。 “传达的信息是对一些防守方面进行一些调整，但同时也让球员对球充满信心。我希望我们继续努力，因为我知道我们会有机会，在那些时刻我们都很冷静。如果周日下午马拉德的第三个进球没有被判越位，她本可以上演帽子戏法，而正是第 9 号球员在第 88 分钟赢得了点球。巴尔的摩队为马拉德送出第二次助攻，并在比赛结束时主罚点球，让邦帕斯特对她的同胞们赞不绝口。 “法国球员今天出现了，这确实是需要的，”主教练继续说道。 “我为他们感到高兴，尤其是桑迪。她最近没有太多时间，但这是她能给我的最好答案。她的表演真的很好。 “当你对阵一支更多地坐在低​​位的球队时，她在传中和控球方面都带来了很大的质量，她可以一对一地击败对手。这对今天来说是一个很大的帮助。 “我没想到梅尔文能像那样远距离得分。正如你在这里所说的，这是一个香肠！她有能力创造这些目标。她对我们来说是一位重要的球员，我为她感到高兴，因为她打进了一个非常困难的进球。之前她本可以轻松得分。这让她的情况变得更好，这样的得分总是有利于她的信心。”

news.title: Match report: Crystal Palace 1-3 Chelsea Women
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：水晶宫 1-3 切尔西女足
news.body_en: A brace from Melvine Malard and a penalty scored by Sandy Baltimore ensured Chelsea recovered from a subpar first half to secure a 3-1 victory away at Crystal Palace. The sun came out on Sunday for our trip to south London after Saturday's torrential rain, but the howling wind wasn't conducive to stroking the ball around on the floor. For all of Chelsea's good work in the opening quarter-of-an-hour, it was the home side who took the lead when Molly Bartrip bundled the ball home from a corner after 20 minutes. Sonia Bompastor's team talk must've had an impact as the Blues emerged with a renewed focus after the break as Malard levelled the scores on 50 minutes with a stunning effort from the edge of the box. The match once again became tight as Palace attempted to preserve the point, but some determined work from substitute Baltimore on the left wing gave her the space to serve up an opportunity on a plate for Malard to head in her second of the afternoon. Baltimore then got herself on the scoresheet when she converted a late penalty after Malard was fouled in the box, ensuring we finished the day on a positive note after our first-half struggles. Bompastor made two alterations to her starting line-up ahead of this fixture, rotating Keira Walsh and Lauren James out of the side in place of Sjoeke Nusken and Maika Hamano. Meanwhile, Manaka Matsukubo made the squad for the first time since joining Chelsea in the summer from North Carolina Courage. The game began with the Blues pushing forward to make an immediate impact, with Alyssa Thompson causing problems for the home side down the left-hand channel and Ellie Carpenter linking up well with central striker Malard on the right. Our first real opportunity of the match came in the 14th minute, when Hamano saw her shot palmed away by the goalkeeper before Malard's shot was cleared off the line by the Palace defence. The strong winds in Sutton were always going to play a part in this contest, and made set-pieces more dangerous for both sides. When Palace swung in their second corner of the match, defender Bartrip popped up at the back post to steer the ball through the resulting melee and into the bottom corner of the net. Chelsea attempted to hit back through a Nusken power drive from inside the penalty area, but Pauline Peyraud-Magnin was able to quickly get low to snuff out the danger. Bompastor made two changes at the break, exchanging Hamano and Thompson for Erin Cuthbert and Baltimore. We showed our attacking intent when Malard went close within minutes of the restart, and it was the French international who got us back on level terms shortly afterwards. Receiving the ball 25 yards from goal from a Katie McCabe throw-in, Malard found herself in space and unleashed a stunning strike that fizzed past a helpless Peyraud-Magnin. But determined Palace were keen to fight back, and there was a let-off when former Blues striker Bethany England got herself into a good position to shoot but blazed her attempt over the bar. Our second goal of the afternoon saw Malard net her brace, but the chance was created solely by Baltimore. Driving towards the box, she sped between two Palace defenders before evading the challenge of a third and making it to the by-line to deliver a looping ball straight to the head of Malard, who wasted no time in nodding the ball home. Our noses were finally in front with 15 minutes to play, and Malard could've had her hat-trick soon afterwards but was denied by the offside flag after taking a slight touch on a brilliant ball in from McCabe. As the home side began to tire, Nusken was unlucky not to get on the scoresheet when she hit the woodwork, and with 88 minutes on the clock the French duo were decisive once again when we were awarded a penalty. Malard won the spot-kick when she was fouled inside the box, and after the number nine received some brief treatment, the ball was passed to Baltimore. The substitute stepped up and converted, securing the points after an excellent second-half display. There was to be one more positive before the final whistle, too, as Matsukubo was handed her Chelsea debut when she was introduced on 90 minutes. This was another resilient performance from the Blues, as we recorded our sixth win from seven WSL games so far this season. We go top of the WSL table, pending Manchester City's result later on. We return to Women's Champions League action when we take on Roma at Plough Lane at 5.45pm on Wednesday. Chelsea: Hampton, Carpenter, Bronze (c), Buchanan, McCabe, Nusken (Dragoni 90), Potter, Kaptein (Beever-Jones 69), Thompson (Baltimore h/t), Hamano (Cuthbert h/t), Malard (Matsukubo 90)Unused substitutes: Peng, Buurman, Las, BrownScorers: Malard 50, 75, Baltimore 90Booked: Kaptein 44, McCabe 44, Bronze 63 Crystal Palace: Peyraud-Magnin, Everett (c), Lloyd-Smith, England, Ladd (Enge 90+5), Blanchard, Larkin, Goldie, Tsunoda, Swaby (Napier 90+5), BartripUnused subs: Yanez, Sharpe, Howat, Weerden, Nolan, Hopcroft, O'BrienScorers: Bartrip 20Booked: Blanchard 44, Ladd 70Referee: Alice Parker
news.body_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德的梅开二度和桑迪·巴尔的摩的点球帮助切尔西从上半场的低迷状态中恢复过来，客场3-1战胜水晶宫。周六的暴雨过后，周日太阳出来了，我们前往伦敦南部旅行，但呼啸的风不利于在地板上抚摸球。尽管切尔西在开场一刻钟表现出色，但 20 分钟后莫莉·巴特里普 (Molly Bartrip) 从角球将球射入球门，主队取得了领先。索尼娅·邦帕斯托的团队讲话一定产生了影响，蓝军在中场休息后重新集中注意力，马拉德在禁区边缘的一脚惊人射门在第 50 分钟扳平了比分。比赛再次变得胶着，水晶宫试图保住这一分，但替补上场的巴尔的摩在左翼的顽强拼搏为她提供了空间，为马拉德在下午的第二场比赛中头球破门。马拉德在禁区内被犯规后，巴尔的摩队在最后时刻罚进点球，取得了进球，确保我们在上半场的挣扎之后以积极的姿态结束这一天。博姆帕斯特在这场比赛之前对首发阵容进行了两次调整，将凯拉·沃尔什和劳伦·詹姆斯轮换出首发阵容，代替舍克·努斯肯和麦卡·滨野。与此同时，自今年夏天从北卡罗来纳勇气队加盟切尔西以来，松久保真中首次入选大名单。比赛一开始，蓝军就立即发起进攻，阿丽莎·汤普森在左路给主队制造了麻烦，而埃莉·卡彭特则与右侧的中锋马拉德配合得很好。我们本场比赛的第一个真正的机会出现在第 14 分钟，当时滨野看到她的射门被门将挡出，随后马拉德的射门被水晶宫后卫挡出了底线。萨顿的强风总是会在这场比赛中发挥作用，并使双方的定位球变得更加危险。当水晶宫开出第二个角球时，后卫巴特里普突然出现在后门柱处，引导球穿过由此产生的混战，进入球网下角。切尔西试图通过禁区内的努斯肯强力反击进行反击，但宝琳·佩罗-马格宁迅速压低身位，化解了危险。邦帕斯托在中场休息时做出了两次换人，将哈野野和汤普森换成了艾琳·库斯伯特和巴尔的摩。当马拉德在比赛重新开始后几分钟内逼近时，我们展现了我们的进攻意图，不久之后正是这位法国国脚让我们扳平了比分。马拉德在距离球门 25 码处接到凯蒂·麦凯布的界外球后，发现自己处于空位，并射出一脚惊人的射门，飞过了无助的佩罗-马宁。但意志坚定的水晶宫渴望反击，前蓝军前锋贝瑟尼·英格兰找到了一个良好的射门位置，但射门高出横梁，导致了一次失误。我们下午的第二个进球是马拉德梅开二度，但这个机会完全是由巴尔的摩创造的。她冲向禁区，在两名水晶宫后卫之间快速穿行，然后躲避了第三名后卫的挑战，并到达边线，将一记弧线球直接传到马拉德的头上，马拉德毫不犹豫地将球打进了球门。比赛还剩 15 分钟时，我们的比分终于领先，马拉德本可以很快上演帽子戏法，但在接住麦凯布的精彩传球后，被越位旗挡出。当主队开始疲倦时，努斯肯不幸击中门框而未能取得进球，在比赛还剩88分钟时，这对法国组合再次发挥了决定性作用，我们获得了点球。马拉德在禁区内被犯规，赢得了点球，9号球员经过短暂治疗后，球传给了巴尔的摩。下半场替补球员上场并完成转换，凭借出色的表现锁定了积分。终场哨响之前还有一个积极的事情，松久保在第 90 分钟上场时完成了切尔西的处子秀。这是蓝军的又一次坚韧表现，本赛季迄今为止，我们在七场 WSL 比赛中取得了第六场胜利。我们在 WSL 积分榜上名列前茅，等待曼城稍后的结果。周三下午 5 点 45 分，我们将回到女子冠军联赛的比赛中，我们将在 Plough Lane 迎战罗马。 切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜（中）、布坎南、麦凯布、努斯肯（德拉戈尼 90）、波特、卡普坦（比弗-琼斯 69）、汤普森（巴尔的摩主队）、滨野（卡斯伯特主队）、马拉德（松久保 90）未上场替补：彭、布尔曼、拉斯、布朗得分手：马拉德 50、75、巴尔的摩 90 黄牌：卡普坦 44、麦凯布 44、铜牌 63 水晶宫：佩罗-马格宁、埃弗雷特（队长）、劳埃德-史密斯、英格兰、拉德（恩格 90+5）、布兰查德、拉金、戈尔迪、角田、斯瓦比（纳皮尔 90+5）、巴特里普未上场替补：亚内兹、夏普、霍瓦特、韦尔登、诺兰、霍普克罗夫特、奥布莱恩记分员：巴特里普 20 黄牌：布兰查德 44，拉德 70 裁判：爱丽丝·帕克

news.title: Lacroix: ‘We must show the reaction of a competitor’
news.title_zh: 拉克鲁瓦：“我们必须展示竞争对手的反应”
news.body_en: Maxence Lacroix is looking to our forthcoming games against Liverpool and Manchester United as an opportunity to put things right after our loss to Tottenham. The Blues were beaten 2-0 at Stamford Bridge on Saturday, putting an abrupt end to our promising recent results. However, there is a chance to hit back in the best way possible by defeating two longstanding rivals, starting with our Carabao Cup fourth round trip to Anfield in midweek. ‘It’s a big game for us,’ said Lacroix. ‘We want to go far in this competition and it’s good that we have a game like this now. We have to move on and work on some details to be stronger in certain moments and change some situations. ‘We have to show the reaction of a competitor. We want to show another face, we want to win there, and it’s going to be a big game.’ Lacroix also offered support to Mike Penders, whose own goal gave Tottenham the lead on his first Premier League start. Xabi Alonso has confirmed the Belgian will start at Anfield on Wednesday, and Lacroix explained how the group will offer support to Penders ahead of that trip. ‘He is a young goalkeeper and he has a lot of talent,’ said Lacroix. ‘He will learn from this. This can happen in football careers and in life, everyone makes mistakes, and we have to be with him and we are going to be with him. We are behind him. He will help us this season and now we have to help him.’
news.body_zh: 马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦（Maxence Lacroix）将接下来对阵利物浦和曼联的比赛视为在输给托特纳姆热刺后扭转局面的机会。周六，蓝军在斯坦福桥被 2-0 击败，为我们近期的希望之战画上句号。然而，我们有机会以最好的方式进行反击，击败两个长期对手，从周中前往安菲尔德的卡拉宝杯第四轮比赛开始。 “这对我们来说是一场重要的比赛，”拉克鲁瓦说。 “我们希望在这场比赛中走得更远，很高兴我们现在有这样的比赛。我们必须继续前进，在一些细节上努力，以便在某些时刻变得更强并改变某些情况。 “我们必须展示竞争对手的反应。我们想要展示另一张面孔，我们想要在那里获胜，这将是一场重要的比赛。”拉克鲁瓦还向迈克·潘德斯表示支持，他的乌龙球让托特纳姆热刺队在他的第一次英超首发中取得了领先。哈维·阿隆索已经确认比利时人将于周三在安菲尔德首发，拉克鲁瓦解释了该团队将如何在那次旅行之前为彭德斯提供支持。 “他是一名年轻的门将，而且很有天赋，”拉克鲁瓦说。 ‘他将从中吸取教训。这可能发生在足球生涯和生活中，每个人都会犯错误，我们必须和他在一起，我们也会和他在一起。我们在他身后。这个赛季他会帮助我们，现在我们必须帮助他。”

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea Women line up vs Crystal Palace
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西女足对阵水晶宫的阵容
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has made two changes to her Chelsea side for our Women's Super League match away at Crystal Palace. The Blues are coming off a 6-2 win over Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge last weekend and now face another test in the WSL against the newly-promoted Eagles. Bompastor has switched Keira Walsh for Sjoeke Nusken, while Maika Hamano – who scored a wonder goal against Spurs – comes in for Lauren James. Lexi Potter starts against the team where she spent two seasons on loan. She helped Palace earn promotion to the WSL in 2023/24 and returned to spend a full campaign in the top flight the following year. And after completing her recovery from injury and scoring a hat-trick for the Under-18s last weekend, summer signing Manaka Matsukubo is named on the bench for the first time this season. news.title: Caicedo: 'Everybody knows what we need to improve'
news.title_zh: 凯塞多：“每个人都知道我们需要改进什么”
news.body_en: Moises Caicedo didn’t search for excuses in his post-match media duties after our defeat to Tottenham Hotspur. And his message was clear: ‘Everybody knows what we need to improve’. The Blues entered yesterday’s game at Stamford Bridge after back-to-back top-flight wins that had seen Bournemouth and then Everton convincingly beaten. We had also not tasted defeat on home soil this season. As Xabi Alonso accepted after the game, we were not at our best across the 90 minutes. Yet we did create chances. Cole Palmer, Jordan Henderson, Morgan Rogers and Pedro Neto all tested Antonin Kinsky in the opening period. Yet in a tight second half, Tottenham broke the deadlock by forcing an own goal from Mike Penders following a corner. Mathys Tel then netted late on to seal the win, with the Blues down to ten men after Cole Palmer was sent off. Caicedo, who wore the captain’s armband, was naturally disappointed with the result and accepted the Blues must learn from the painful defeat. He said: ‘We need to be focused during the whole game because if you switch off for one second, you get punished. ‘We need to learn from this because we need to stop this from happening and we need to maintain the clean sheet for the whole game. ‘It was a tough one, but we need to keep going because there are more games in front of us and we want to do better.’ The Ecuadorian midfielder added: ‘Everybody knows what we need to improve. We are going to think about this game because we need to be up there in the table.  We need to learn from this and for sure we are going to be up there [at the end of the season].’ For Caicedo, the game saw his third start in succession after overcoming an early-season injury. The 24-year-old was impressive in the middle of the pitch, winning a game-high four interceptions and making two tackles. ‘I tried to do my best and help the team and for sure I’m feeling better game by game,’ he explained. ‘This one was a tough game but I want to keep doing well and improving what I need to improve because I want to be someone that helps the team in every moment.’
news.body_zh: 在我们输给托特纳姆热刺队后，莫伊塞斯·凯塞多并没有在他的赛后媒体职责中寻找借口。他的信息很明确：“每个人都知道我们需要改进什么”。蓝军在连续两场顶级联赛胜利后进入了昨天在斯坦福桥的比赛，其中伯恩茅斯和埃弗顿都被令人信服地击败。本赛季我们在主场也没有尝到失败的滋味。正如哈维·阿隆索赛后承认的那样，我们在 90 分钟内并没有处于最佳状态。但我们确实创造了机会。科尔·帕尔默、乔丹·亨德森、摩根·罗杰斯和佩德罗·内托都在开场阶段考验了安东尼·金斯基。然而，在紧张的下半场，托特纳姆热刺队在角球后迫使迈克·彭德斯自摆乌龙，打破了僵局。马蒂斯·特尔随后在最后时刻进球锁定胜局，在科尔·帕尔默被罚下场后，蓝军的人数只剩下十人。戴上队长袖标的凯塞多自然对结果感到失望，并认为蓝军必须从惨痛的失败中吸取教训。他说：“我们需要在整场比赛中保持专注，因为如果你停顿一秒钟，你就会受到惩罚。 “我们需要从中吸取教训，因为我们需要阻止这种情况发生，我们需要保持整场比赛不失球。 “这是一场艰难的比赛，但我们需要继续前进，因为我们面前还有更多比赛，我们想要做得更好。”这位厄瓜多尔中场补充道：“每个人都知道我们需要改进什么。”我们会考虑这场比赛，因为我们需要在积分榜上名列前茅。  我们需要从中吸取教训，并且确信我们将在赛季末达到目标。”对于凯塞多来说，这场比赛是他在克服赛季初伤病后连续第三次首发。这位24岁的球员在中场的表现令人印象深刻，赢得了全场最高的四次拦截并完成了两次铲断。 “我尽力做到最好，帮助球队，当然我每一场比赛都感觉更好，”他解释道。 “这是一场艰难的比赛，但我想继续表现出色，并改进我需要改进的地方，因为我想成为每时每刻都能帮助球队的人。”
